svg.aria-label: Cuneiform Drift: how a patch of text melts into a cuneiform sign and heals
svg.title: Cuneiform Drift: how a patch of text melts into a cuneiform sign and heals
svg.text: A browser extension. Now and then, a patch of the page you are reading lets go.
Also: words shed tiny clay wedges · wedge marks travel with the page as you scroll · faint signs grow in empty margins and crumble.
Gentle by default (a melt about every 10 s, each fading in over ~20 s). Respects “reduce motion”. Nothing leaves your browser.
